entries.title: Psalms 6:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. On an eight-stringed harp. A Psalm of David.>> O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger, Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure.

entries.title: Psalms 6:2
segments: Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I [am] weak; O LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 6:3
segments: My soul also is greatly troubled; But You, O LORD-how long?

entries.title: Psalms 6:4
segments: Return, O LORD, deliver me! Oh, save me for Your mercies' sake!

entries.title: Psalms 6:5
segments: For in death [there is] no remembrance of You; In the grave who will give You thanks?

entries.title: Psalms 6:6
segments: I am weary with my groaning; All night I make my bed swim; I drench my couch with my tears.

entries.title: Psalms 6:7
segments: My eye wastes away because of grief; It grows old because of all my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 6:8
segments: ¶Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; For the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

entries.title: Psalms 6:9
segments: The LORD has heard my supplication; The LORD will receive my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 6:10
segments: Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; Let them turn back [and] be ashamed suddenly.
